name: Kamiita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kamiita town emblem in white: a winged device above a ring with diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Kamiita, a town in Tokushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1972.

features.role: Kamiita town emblem — a winged device above a ring with diagonal strokes
